script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: “What the card said” refers to the lesson interface, which Papa Dorin does not talk about.
The LORD says He will remove those who rejoice in their pride, not that pride itself is what He removes.
Calling the meek and humble people “quiet folks” adds a characteristic the passage does not give them.
The opening repeats the answer without adding a meaningful comparison or a laugh. The rest simply repeats the verse.
Shouting at a cookie does not fit the reason for rejoicing or make a clear comparison.
The claim that people lose land a lot in the Bible goes beyond this passage and has no reference.
“And then” makes the singing a later event. The verse does not establish that sequence.
The teacher-with-a-test comparison evokes a school scenario, which is outside the audience rules.
The passage does not say the lame have the hardest time getting somewhere or that nobody is left behind.
The passage does not say the lame cannot get somewhere on their own; it says the LORD will save them.
Praise and fame throughout the earth do not establish that the people will be physically close to everybody.
